import httpx

url = "https://example.com/big.bin"
output_file = "big.bin"
chunk_size = 8192

with httpx.stream("GET", url) as response:
    response.raise_for_status()
    with open(output_file, "wb") as f:
        for chunk in response.iter_bytes(chunk_size=chunk_size):
            if chunk:
                f.write(chunk)
